statement.zh: 用卡斯马（下塞钦/塞钦阿尔托）或不奇科测年主张「美洲最早文明/城市」排名——属比较修辞，非档案义务。
statement.en: Using Casma (Sechín Bajo / Sechín Alto) or Norte Chico dates to claim ‘earliest civilization/city in the Americas’ rankings is comparative rhetoric, not an archival duty.

disclaimer: HYPOTHESIS — primacy/ranking language is marketing or comparative framing; archive records dated architecture per site without world ranking.
